enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Parrying +3: +3 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +3 Insight bonus to Saves.
Doublestrike 9%: Passive: 9% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.
Insightful Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
